faq.sectionDescription: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.contactHint: Our team can help with setup, licensing, and onboarding your travel agency.

items.question: What does 'self-hosted' mean?
items.answer: Self-hosted means you install and run the platform on your own server (or VPS). You have full control over your data, your domain, and your branding. We provide the Docker image — you provide the server.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to set this up?
items.answer: Basic familiarity with servers helps, but our one-command installer and setup wizard handle everything. If you can copy and paste a command into a terminal, you can deploy Rihla Mate. We also offer assisted setup for Enterprise customers.

items.question: How does licensing work?
items.answer: Each instance requires a license key tied to your domain. Licenses are validated using Ed25519 cryptographic signatures — no constant phone-home, just periodic check-ins. Licenses are monthly and can be canceled anytime.

items.question: Can I use my own domain name?
items.answer: Yes. You can use any domain you own. The platform supports custom domains with automatic SSL via a reverse proxy like Nginx or Caddy.

items.question: What payment methods are supported?
items.answer: We integrate with Midtrans, Indonesia's leading payment gateway. This includes GoPay, OVO, Dana, QRIS, bank transfer (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI), credit/debit cards, and convenience store payments.

items.question: Can I customize the design?
items.answer: Yes. The platform supports full white-label branding: your logo, brand colors, and custom CSS. You can also modify the landing page templates to match your agency's identity.

items.question: What happens if I stop paying the license?
items.answer: If your license expires, the platform enters a 7-day grace period with full functionality. After that, it degrades to a limited mode. Your data is never locked — you can always export your data even without an active license.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. Since the platform runs on your server, all customer data, booking records, and payment information stay on your infrastructure. We never have access to your data.

guide.title: How to run your bureau with Rihla Mate
guide.lead: This guide is for Umrah travel-agency staff: install, sign-in, packages, bookings, payments, pilgrims, site content, license, and settings. There is no public self-registration — accounts are created in the installer or Users.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.body: If setup is not finished, open the installer. If you already have an account, sign in to the dashboard.

who.title: Who this is for
who.body: The Rihla Mate dashboard is your bureau staff panel (admin, CS, operations). It is not a platform-operator console. Pilgrims use the public catalog and booking flow; staff work in /dashboard.
notes: Pilgrims do not log in to the dashboard.

server.title: Minimum VPS / server specs
server.body: For self-host (Docker Compose: app + PostgreSQL + Watchtower). PostgreSQL 16 and Node.js 22 ship in the image — no manual install. A reverse proxy (Nginx/Caddy) is recommended for SSL.
steps: Provision a VPS with a public IP or domain.
Install Docker 24+ and Compose v2.
Fetch docker-compose.yml, fill .env, then docker compose up -d.
Expose port 3000 (or 443 via reverse proxy), then open the installer.
notes: Storage covers OS, Docker images, the database, and uploads. Use SSD.
2 GB RAM is enough for one quiet bureau; add RAM if concurrent users grow.
The central license server is not deployed on the bureau VPS.

start.title: First-time setup (bureau admin)
start.body: After the app is running, open the installer once: system check, admin account, then license or 14-day trial.
steps: Open /installer (for example https://rihla.my.id/id/installer).
Confirm the database is connected.
Enter admin name, email, and password (min. 8 characters).
Activate a license key or start a trial.
Sign in with the admin email you just created.
notes: Without this step, Sign in fails because no user exists yet.
License activation is also available at /activate.

login.title: Daily sign-in
login.body: Staff with accounts use /sign-in. There is no public Sign up button.
steps: Open /sign-in.
Use email and password, or Google if OAuth is configured.
You land on the dashboard.
notes: Google OAuth only appears when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and secret are set.

staff.title: Inviting bureau staff
staff.body: Admins create extra accounts in Users. Pilgrims never self-register for the dashboard.
steps: Sign in as admin.
Open Users in the sidebar.
Create a user and choose the role available in the form.
Share email and password with staff out of band.
notes: Do not share the admin account with everyone — create separate users.

packages.title: Manage Umrah packages
packages.body: Packages are what pilgrims see. Fill title, URL slug, price, duration, departures, and description.
steps: Dashboard → Packages → new package.
Fill title, slug (lowercase, no spaces), price, duration in days.
Add departure dates and quota when available.
Save. The package appears at /packages/[slug].
notes: Slugs must be unique and use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

bookings.title: Bookings from the site and the desk
bookings.body: Pilgrims can book from a package page. Staff can also create walk-in or WhatsApp bookings.
steps: Dashboard → Bookings for the full list.
New booking: package, customer, date, travelers, total price.
Open booking detail for status, payment, and notes.
notes: Status follows the system flow: pending, down payment, paid, or cancelled.

customers.title: Customer / pilgrim records
customers.body: Customers stores names, contacts, and booking history. Use it for follow-up and to avoid duplicates.
steps: Open Customers in the sidebar.
Search a name, then open the profile for booking history.

payments.title: Midtrans payments
payments.body: With Midtrans configured, pilgrims can pay via GoPay, OVO, Dana, or QRIS. Staff see status on the booking.
steps: Ensure Midtrans keys are in the environment.
From booking detail, open payment if unpaid.
After Midtrans notifies the app, booking status updates.
notes: Without Midtrans, record payments operationally and update status in the dashboard.

catalog.title: Photos and media
catalog.body: Upload images for the catalog (local or S3 via STORAGE_DRIVER).
steps: Dashboard → Media.
Upload photos, then attach them to packages or CMS pages.

cms.title: Content pages (CMS)
cms.body: Create info pages: terms, itinerary, about the bureau. Pilgrims read them on the public site.
steps: Dashboard → Pages → new.
Fill title, slug, and body.
Publish so they appear on the site.

analytics.title: Analytics and overview
analytics.body: See booking and revenue trends in Analytics and summary cards on the dashboard home.
steps: Open Dashboard for daily figures.
Open Analytics for trends.

license.title: License and trial
license.body: Start with a 14-day trial, then a license key. The app checks in periodically. After expiry, a grace period applies before features degrade.
steps: Dashboard → License for plan and expiry.
Enter a new key at /activate when renewing.
notes: Do not share license keys in public chats.

settings.title: Bureau settings
settings.body: Adjust bureau identity, locale, and options in Settings. Advanced branding follows the license plan.
steps: Dashboard → Settings.
Save before leaving.

tips.title: Operational practice
tips.body: Treat Rihla Mate as the source of truth, not a disconnected spreadsheet.
steps: One admin owns installer and Users.
CS owns bookings and pilgrims.
Operations owns packages, media, and pages.
Check the license before peak season (Ramadan / year-end).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains how Rihla Mate (rihla.my.id) collects and uses data when you visit the product site, try the demo, or use licensed software.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Rihla Mate is white-label software for Umrah travel bureaus. The product site at rihla.my.id markets licenses and documentation. Customer installs run on the customer’s own server (self-hosted), not on our shared infrastructure.

collect.title: Data we collect
collect.body: On the product site we may log IP address, user-agent, pages visited, and information you submit (for example a contact email). If you activate a license, the customer server sends periodic check-ins to the license server (license identity and instance status, not pilgrim records). License payments are processed by a third-party payment provider. We do not operate your bureau’s pilgrim database.

cookies.title: Cookies and sessions
cookies.body: The site uses cookies or session storage required for language, security, and (on an instance) staff authentication. We do not run third-party advertising on the product site.

purpose.title: How we use data
purpose.body: We use data to operate the site, respond to requests, enforce licenses, prevent abuse, and improve the product. We do not sell personal data.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: We may use infrastructure, transactional email, and payment providers. They receive only what is needed for that service. Pilgrim data on a bureau install is controlled by the bureau, not Rihla Mate, unless the bureau separately sends it to us (for example a support ticket).

retention.title: Retention and your rights
retention.body: Technical logs are kept as needed for security and operations. For access, correction, or deletion of data we hold about a license account or contact, email mail@rihla.my.id. Requests about pilgrim data must go to the bureau operating the install.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Privacy questions: mail@rihla.my.id. Product site: https://rihla.my.id.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: By accessing rihla.my.id or using Rihla Mate software, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the site or software.

product.title: The product
product.body: Rihla Mate is self-hosted software for Umrah bureau operations (catalog, bookings, dashboard). rihla.my.id is the SaaS product surface, not an Umrah booking site. The demo on a separate domain shows a sample bureau brand and is not a travel offer from Rihla Mate.

license.title: License and trial
license.body: Use of the software is subject to the issued license (including any trial). One install is intended for one bureau. You may not copy, sublicense, or circumvent license checks. Features may be limited if a license expires or is revoked, as stated in the license.

account.title: Your responsibilities
account.body: You are responsible for your server, backups, credential security, CMS content, pilgrim data, travel/visa compliance, and communication with pilgrims. Rihla Mate is not a travel bureau and does not sell Umrah packages.

acceptable.title: Unacceptable use
acceptable.body: You may not use the product for fraud, unlawful activity, service disruption, or content that infringes others’ rights. We may refuse activation or revoke a license for material breach.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: Rihla Mate trademarks, code, and marketing materials remain ours or our licensors’. Content you put in your install remains yours or your licensors’.

liability.title: Disclaimer and liability
liability.body: The software is provided as is. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect loss, data loss, or business interruption. Aggregate liability related to a license is limited to the fees you paid for that license in the preceding 12 months, unless mandatory law requires otherwise.
